note: Every table names the ONE service that may read and write it. A table absent from this file is a build error, never a silently skipped row — completeness is the point. Owners are package names, never paths (Ruling 5).

unowned.note: Ruling 6 — no unowned tables. These three are what remains of the completeness defect. Until an owner is named NOBODY may touch them, which is what the model already says.

tables.sessions: run-orchestration is the owner — 3 packages touch the table; the layer-side accessors move behind it.
tables.propagationLog: policy(9), core-api(3), work(2) — owner plus a door for 5 sites.
tables.taskDispatchAttempts: work(8), policy(3) — owner plus a door for 3 sites.
